newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar hovers rangebound, trade routine.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar hovers rangebound, trade routine.

text.p: White sugar futures remained tightly mixed in routine trade as the two nearby contracts dominated market interest, traders said on Monday.
Commission house players boosted turnover with crosses of the December/March spread, although there was also trade interest at around $4, they said.

"It's quite quiet today, I don't think there's a lot going on," said one. At 1542 GMT December was up 90 cents at $326.00, just off its intraday high. March was down 10 cents at $321.70 and overall volume totalled a light 939 lots.
Traders reported a general lack of fresh physical news after last week's spate of buying tenders.
Activity in Paris was dull with just 396 lots traded. The December and March contracts were both down 10 cents, at $325.50 and $322.00 respectively.
